title: Dog Night, 2017 · after
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The morning after eighteen years: the box under the table, and the pup asleep against it as he does now, and Wood drawing the outline from memory — the rectangle in the gravel — on a small sheet, and pinning it on the garage board. The board gets a rectangle. Nobody asks what it is.

panels.composition: The garage. The PUP asleep against the small box under the table. WOOD at the table drawing.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small three-legged dog asleep against a small cardboard box under a drafting table while a man draws above

panels.composition: The sheet: a rectangle, darker inside, gravel texture. Nothing else.
